Name: Simple Electricity System
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿ to implement electricity objects for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url].

The following objects will require power using this mod:

[list]
[*]Coffee Maker: 1 power
[*]Recycling Machine: 1 power
[*]Soda Machine: 1 power
[*]Deconstructor: 2 power
[*]Ostrich Incubator: 2 power
[*]Slime Incubator: 2 power
[*]Wood Chipper: 2 power
[*]Crystalarium
[/list]
The following objects will produce power using this mod:

[list]
[*]Charcoal Kiln: 10 power, only while performing work
[*]Furnace: 10 power, only while performing work
[*]Solar Panel: 10 power, only while sun is shining
[/list]
This mod adds a recipe to the kiln allowing 10 coal to burn for approximately 2 days with no product.

Also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10198]Simple Irrigation System[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
